notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi treasure seekers!



We hope you're all enjoying BALL x PIT demo!

We're rolling out a small patch for the demo, so make sure to update the game before your next session.



Patch Notes:

Projectiles and player now use 3D colliders, so being hitboxes match visuals a bit better. There will still be a bit of leniency as the player's hitbox will be much narrower than the character. 

Add setting to disable swirling background in fuser ui 

Let boss crown flash even if 'reduce flashing colors' is enabled 

Adjust freeze damage color to be less cyan 

Increase/decrease game speed is now remappable on the keyboard 

Various Bug fixes



That's all for now! We encourage you to join our Discord server to report bugs, give feedback, and share suggestions with us.



Thank you for your support!
